assignment.assignment_objective: Using the strategic foundation created in Assignment 1, develop a content and social media strategy that shows how your brand will attract, engage and build relationships with its target audience.

criteria.\"1. Strategic relevance: Does the content make sense for this brand, this consumer and this objective?"

criteria.\"2. Creative thinking: Are the ideas interesting and distinctive rather than generic social-media content?"

criteria.\"3. Platform understanding: Have they understood that different platforms require different behaviours and formats?"

criteria.\"4. Integration: Does everything feel like it belongs to one coherent brand strategy?"

evaluation_criteria.heading: This assignment will be evaluated on -

assignment.recommended_length: No recommended length of slides, but an outline is given below. Feel free to increase/ decrease the number of slides as per your content.
assignment.submission: Presentation - PPT/PDF/Google slides (continue with the same format as last assignment, in the same document)
assignment.subtitle: Build your brand's digital content ecosystem

content: What does content need to achieve for your brand?
suggested_slide_structure.explanation: You should then explain why these objectives matter for your brand and audience.
suggested_slide_structure.title: Content Marketing Objective

communication_principles.description: What should your brand communication always / never feel like?

content: Define how the brand should communicate online.
suggested_slide_structure.core_brand_message: What is the one idea you want consumers to associate with the brand?
suggested_slide_structure.sample_copy: You can include 3 - 5 sample lines of copy to demonstrate the tone. (This is where our Gymshark tone- of- voice discussion can be referred to, and used)
suggested_slide_structure.title: Brand Story & Communication

content: Develop 3 - 5 content pillars for the brand.
Each pillar should have a clear purpose.
suggested_slide_structure.explanation: You must explain: Why would the target audience care about this content? (This prevents content pillars from becoming generic buckets like \"Product\", \"Educational\", \"Fun\")
suggested_slide_structure.title: Content Pillars

suggested_slide_structure.note: You do not need to be everywhere. Choosing not to use a platform is also a strategic decision. You should justify your selection based on the persona created in Assignment 1.
suggested_slide_structure.title: Platform Strategy

content: Choose one content idea/campaign and show how it would change across the selected platforms.

executions.execution: Founder story explaining why the product was created

suggested_slide_structure.principle: The core idea stays consistent, but the execution changes according to platform behaviour.
suggested_slide_structure.title: One Idea, Different Platforms

content: Content Idea -> Content Pillar -> Platform -> Format -> Objective

example.content_idea: What's Actually in Your 4 PM Snack?

suggested_slide_structure.requirement: At least 2 ideas should be developed visually as rough mock-ups/storyboards.
suggested_slide_structure.title: Content Concepts

content: Develop one larger social/content idea for the brand.
include: Insight -> Big Idea -> Key Message -> Execution
suggested_slide_structure.note: (You don't need to create a fully integrated campaign yet. The objective is to demonstrate that you can move from consumer insight -> creative idea)
suggested_slide_structure.title: Hero Content / Campaign Idea

content: How will your brand turn followers into participants?
suggested_slide_structure.explanation: For each, briefly explain why someone would participate.
suggested_slide_structure.title: Community & Engagement Strategy

content.\"Define: Who should be the influencer for my brand?"

include: Type of creator Nano / Micro / Macro / Celebrity
Why they are credible for the brand

then.\"For each creator, explain: Why this person + why this brand? Not: \"They have 2 million followers.\" (The quality of the fit matters more than the follower count)"

suggested_slide_structure.title: Influencer / Creator Strategy

suggested_slide_structure.note: (Do not post just to fill the calendar. Frequency should have a rationale)
suggested_slide_structure.title: Two-Week Content Calendar

suggested_slide_structure.answer: Then answer: After one month, how would you know whether your strategy is working? (No need for any advanced analytics yet)
suggested_slide_structure.closing: Strategy first. Design second. Every creative decision should have a reason.
content: Students define 5 - 7 metrics they would track.
But they must connect each metric to an objective.
suggested_slide_structure.title: Measurement & Success

assignment.title: 2: Content & Social Media Strategy
